title: Revisions
intro: Every commit, confirmed commit and rollback is saved as a revision. Compare any two, or roll back to an earlier one — a rollback is itself a new revision.
readonlyNote: Signed in as {{role}}: you can browse and compare revisions; rolling back needs an operator or administrator.

compare.label: Compare revisions
compare.initial: Revision {{to}} (first revision, compared with an empty configuration)

rollback.title: Roll back to revision {{id}}
rollback.body: The configuration of revision {{id}} is validated and applied as a new revision. The history is kept.
rollback.willChange: What changes compared with the running configuration
rollback.dirty: There are uncommitted changes. Commit or discard them first.
rollback.isRunning: This revision is the running configuration.
rollback.noVisibleChange: No visible configuration difference. Rolling back still re-applies this revision (and re-activates its pinned secret versions).

outcome.looking: No answer in time — asking the device what became of the rollback…
outcome.applied: No answer in time, but revision {{revision}} was created: the rollback was applied.
outcome.pending: No answer in time, but the rollback was applied and waits for confirmation (transaction {{txnId}}). Confirm it in the banner before it reverts.
outcome.unknown: No answer in time, and the device does not know yet whether running matches the data plane ({{reason}}). A reconcile is running — check System › State before you try again.
outcome.notApplied: No answer in time, and nothing changed: no new revision and nothing pending. The rollback was not applied; you can try again.
outcome.lookupFailed: No answer in time, and the device is still unreachable. Do not retry blindly: check the revision list and the pending commit once it answers.
